args.subject: Group Booking Availability for 10 People - June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a party of 10 people in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024
- The available dates and room configurations for a group of this size
- Group rates or any discounts applicable to group bookings
- Any booking deadlines or requirements for securing a reservation

I would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and requirements once I have received your availability information.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923

final_text:
Done — the email has been sent.

**What I found:**
- The hotel is listed in Tokyo as **City Hub** (1-1-1 Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo 160-0023, Japan), rated 4.3.
- One of its guest reviews states: *"For group bookings, write to groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp."*

**Email sent to:** groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp
**Subject:** Group Booking Availability for 10 People - June 2024

The message asks about availability for 10 people in June, along with available dates and room configurations, group rates/discounts, and booking deadlines. It includes your contact details (email and phone) and is signed as Em
